dilit: dilyt (dilyn) — to follow, pursue, keep on with; verbal noun (Dilit y gyuedach a wnaethant 'pursuing the carousing they did'); no mutation
ymdidan: ymdidan (ymddiddan) — conversation, to converse; noun/verbal noun, base form (dechreu ymdidan a wnaeth ef)
a: a — (1) preverbal/relative particle before a verb, causes soft mutation (Pwyll … a oed; ef a welei); (2) 'and' before a consonant, spirant mutation (a chanu, a fob); (3) 'with' (a'y gydymdeithon; gyt a thi); (4) vocative particle (A unben); (5) 'whoever, what' before a verb (a del 'whoever may come'; a wnaethost 'what you did') · (6) 3 sg. present of mynet 'goes' (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there'; yd a hitheu 'she goes'); (7) interrogative particle before a verb (a oes …? 'is there …?'; a dywedy di …? 'will you tell …?'); (8) in a'y kymriw neu archolleu the editorial a'y stands for the conjunction ae 'either' (ae … neu 'either … or'; the Red Book has ae kymriw ae archolleu): read the two halves together as ae · (9) 'as' after an equative (kyn debycket a'r mab 'as like as the boy'; kyn ureisket oed a mab chweblwyd 'as stout as a boy of six')
wnaethant: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 pl. preterite 'they did', soft-mutated after a (eisted a wnaethant)
y: y — (1) the article 'the' (y llys); (2) 'his, her, its' (y uryt: soft mutation = his; y hymdidan: h-prefix = her); (3) 'to' (y hela, y gyuoeth); (4) preverbal particle after a fronted adverb or object (yno y bu, Pwyll... a oed); (5) the relative in oblique relations (o'r a welsei) · (6) 'from' in y gan, y wrth 'from, compared with' (y gan y uarch 'from his horse'; y wrth y ffryt hi 'compared with her form'); (7) infixed object 'him, her, it' after a (a'y guelei 'who saw her'); (8) in a'y kymriw it is the second letter of ae 'either' (see a) · also (9) y am, y amdanaw 'from about, off' (y amdanaw 'off him'); y am hynny 'around that, beyond that, besides' · also (10) 'their' (for eu), with no mutation (y bot 'their being'; y kymryt 'their taking' = to take them) · also (11) 'in' (y'th wlat ti 'in your country') · (12) the particle y before mae introducing a reported fact (y may brawt … a wnaeth hynny 'that it is a brother who did that')
nos: nos (nos) — night; noun f. (y nos honno 'that night')
tra: tra (tra) — while; conjunction (tra deweis wrthyt ti 'while I kept silent') · also (2) 'very', before an adjective with spirant mutation (tra chyuoethauc 'very mighty'); (3) 'while' with the verb sometimes soft-mutated (tra barhaud)
uu: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. preterite 'was' (bu), soft-mutated after a (tirionwch... a uu y ryngthunt)
da: da — good; adjective, also 'goods, wealth' as a noun (treulaw dy da 'spending your wealth')
ganthunt: gan — conjugated preposition 'with them' (ni bu newydach ganthunt 'it was no more novel to them')
chyuedach: kyuedach (cyfeddach) — carousing, a drinking-feast; noun m., spirant-mutated after a (a chyuedach 'and carousing')
phan: pan (pan) — when; spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A phan doeth yno)
welsant: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 3 pl. preterite 'they saw' (-sant) (pan welsant 'when they saw'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after pan 'when'
uot: bot (bod) — to be; verbal noun, soft-mutated after a (ef a eill uot yn ediuar gennyf) · also soft as the complement of a verb (a dylyei uot 'that ought to be')
yn: yn — (1) 'in' (yn Arberth; nasal mutation: yn nyblyc); (2) predicative 'as' with soft mutation (yn wisc hela, yn arglwyd); (3) with a verbal noun, progressive (yn dyuot 'coming'); (4) before an adjective, adverbial (yn llawen 'gladly') · (5) yn yd 'to where' (ymchwelut yn yd oed Pwyll 'returning to where Pwyll was')
llessach: lles (lles) — benefit, good; llessach 'better, more beneficial', comparative formed on the noun (oed llessach y'r march 'it would have been better for the horse')
udunt: y (i) + wynt — conjugated preposition 'to them' (Amser a doeth udunt e uynet e gyscu)
uynet: mynet (mynd) — to go; verbal noun, soft-mutated after e/y (e uynet e gyscu 'to go to sleep')
gyscu: kyscu (cysgu) — to sleep; verbal noun, soft-mutated after y (y gyscu 'to sleep')
noc: no (na) — than; spelling before a vowel (noc a uu 'than what was')
eisted: eisted (eistedd) — to sit; verbal noun (eisted a wnaethant 'they sat')
wei: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'might be', soft-mutated after a (Peth bynnac o garueidrwyd a wei y rungthunt)
hwy: hwy (hwy) — 'they, them'; independent 3 pl. pronoun (arnunt hwy 'over them') · also 'longer', comparative of hir (Ny bu hwy ganthunt no thrannoeth 'it was no longer with them than the next day')
yd: yd — preverbal particle used when the clause opens with an adverb rather than the subject, introducing an indicative main verb (A threigylgweith yd oed yn Arberth)
aethant: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 pl. preterite 'they went' (yd aethant 'they went')
ac: a — 'and' before a vowel (ac ef); also the preposition a 'with' before a vowel (ymgael ac ef 'meet with him', ymordiwes ac ef) · the manuscript also writes ac before some consonants (Ac wal, Ac val, ac racdaw) · also 'as' after an equative or kymeint (kymeint ac ynot ti 'as much as in you'; mor anwedus ac ar y wnaethoed 'as unseemly as what she had done')
yuelly: yuelly (felly) — thus, so, in that way; adverb, the particle y fused with uelly (a chyt kerych di uot yuelly 'though you wish it to be so'; Ac yuelly y gwnaethpwyt 'and so it was done'); no mutation
treulyssant: treulio (treulio) — to spend, pass (time); 3 pl. preterite in -yssant 'they spent' (Uelly y treulyssant blwydyn a blwydyned 'so they spent a year and years'); no mutation after the particle y
wled: gwled (gwledd) — feast, banquet; noun f., soft-mutated after the article y as a feminine noun (y wled 'the feast'; y wled honno 'that feast')
drwy: trwy (trwy) — through; preposition, soft-mutated form (drwy y dewred ef 'through his valour')
digriuwch: digrifwch (digrifwch) — amusement, pleasure; noun m., spelt with u for f (drwy digriuwch 'in pleasure')
hynny: hynny — 'that (thing)'; demonstrative pronoun, very frequent (a hynny 'and that')
kychwynnwys: kychwyn (cychwyn) — to set out, depart; 3 sg. preterite 'set out' (Ac y kychwynnwys Teirnon 'and Teirnon set out'), -wys; no mutation after the particle y
matholwch: Proper name — Matholwch, king of Ireland; radical, no mutation (subject or in apposition: mae ymma Matholwch brenhin Iwerdon)
gyt: kyt (cyd) — together; in y gyt (a) 'together (with)' (y gyt ac wynt 'together with them')
ef: ef (ef) — 'he, him'; independent 3 sg. m. pronoun
parth: parth (parth) — towards, side, direction; noun m./preposition (parth a'y lys 'towards his court')
iwerdon: Proper name — Iwerddon (Ireland); noun f.; no mutation (vowel)
o: o (o) — (1) 'of, from' preposition; (2) 'if' before a verb (o gwneuthum gam 'if I did wrong') · also 'on, by' (o pedestric 'on foot'), 'out of, from' (o'th garyat ti 'from love of you'), 'of' a kind (pryt … o uorwyn 'the looks of (any) maiden') · also agent after a verbal noun, 'by' (troi o Pwyll y got 'Pwyll turning the bag'); o gosp 'of punishment'
teir: tair (tair) — three; numeral, feminine form teir (mab teir blwyd 'a boy of three years'); no mutation
llong: llong (llong) — ship; noun f. (teir llong ar dec 'thirteen ships'); no mutation (after teir)
ar: ar — (1) preposition 'on, upon; at' (ar Hafgan; ar y carw; ar y gilyd 'against the other'); (2) the article yr after a vowel, 'that which' (noc ar a uu 'than what was'; Ar ny del 'and whoever does not come') · also (3) 'with, accompanied by' (ar y ganuet marchauc 'with his hundred horsemen'); 'in' (ar y ssynnwyr e hun 'in his own senses'; ar perued y digrifwch 'in the middle of the merriment'); ar neill law Pwyll 'on one side of Pwyll'; ar uyrr 'quickly'; ar hynny 'thereupon' (see yny) · also 'over' (ar yr ynys hon 'over this island'); 'after the manner of' (ar ureint kyweirdeb 'in the manner of the arrangement'); 'on' a decision (disgynnu ar gymryt hynny 'settled on taking that'); 'ar ol' 'after' (ar ol Matholwch 'after Matholwch'); ar dec 'on ten' (see dec)
dec: tec (teg) — fair, pleasing; adjective (yn dec 'fairly'); soft-mutated (t>d) after predicative yn · also deg (deg) 'ten', written dec (teir llong ar dec 'thirteen ships', literally 'three ships on ten'); no mutation
doethant: dyuot (dod) — to come; 3 pl. preterite 'they came' (Y'r llys y doethant 'to the court they came')
hyt: hyt (hyd) — as far as, until; preposition/conjunction (hyt ym penn y ulwydyn 'until the year's end'; hyt na bo 'so that there be not') · also ar hyt 'along' (ar hyt y prifford 'along the highway') · also 'as far as, so far as, as much as, to the extent that' with the subjunctive (hyt y mynnych 'as much as you wish'; hyt y gallwyf y gaffael 'as far as I can get it'); hyt oet y wled 'until the time of the feast' · also 'so that' with the indicative (hyt nat oed rym 'so that there was no use'); hyt yn Aberfraw 'as far as Aberffraw'
lywenyd: llywenyd (llawenydd) — joy, gladness; noun m. (diruawr lywenyd 'huge gladness'); soft-mutated (ll>l) after the preceding adjective diruawr
ny: ny (ni/nid) — negative particle 'not', base form before a consonant with soft mutation · also spirant mutation of c, p, t (ny chewch 'you will not get'; ny thygyawd 'it did not avail'); soft mutation of g (ny wybydei 'knew not')
wr: gwr (gŵr) — man; noun m., soft-mutated as object (ansyberwyt uwy ar wr) · also soft after y 'to' (y wr 'to a man, to a husband') · also soft in address (A wr 'O man') and after ryw 'kind of' (pa ryw wr 'what kind of man')
mawr: mawr (mawr) — big, great; adjective (uarch erchlas mawr 'a big dapple-grey horse')
na: na — (1) negative particle in a subordinate clause, 'not' (na dywedy di); (2) 'neither/nor' in a series (na guas ystauell, na swydawc) · also negative imperative 'do not', with soft mutation (na ouyn di 'do not ask'; na yrrwch geu arnaf 'do not lay a lie on me'; na hawl ef 'do not claim him')
gwreic: gwreic (gwraig) — wife, woman; noun f., meaning as context decides (a'y wreic 'and his wife')
e: y — 'his', spelt e before a following consonant or in some spellings: e gwn 'his dogs', e weneb 'his face'; also the preposition 'to' in e uynet 'to go' · also 'her', with h- before a vowel (e hymlit hi 'to pursue her'); the verbal particle y (e deuthum i 'I came'); y of y wrth 'from' (e wrthaw 'from him'); and in e uynyd 'up', e ymdeith 'away' · also the article 'the' (E brenhin, E chwedyl 'the king', 'the news'); 'it' as dummy subject (E doeth im 'it came to me')
ymwlet: ymwelet (ymweld) — to see, visit; verbal noun; a scribal spelling with a letter dropped (ymwlet a'y eniuer)
branwen: Proper name — Branwen, daughter of Llŷr; radical (object of erchi 'to ask for')
ni: ni — (1) 1 pl. pronoun 'we/us' (yd ymdidanyssam ni); (2) negative particle, spelling variant of ny before some verbs (ni ladaf, ni bu)
hi: hi — 'she, her'; independent 3 sg. f. pronoun
ae: ae (ae) — either … or; correlative conjunction (ae a'e droet ae a throssawl 'either with his foot or with a staff'); no mutation
ydaw: y (i) + ef — 'to him'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. m., spelt ydaw (heb gynnhic ydaw 'without offering to him'); no mutation
uei: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'might be', soft-mutated after a (a uei uwy no hynny) · also soft-mutated after ban 'when' (ban uei uwyaf 'when it was most')
welet: gwelet (gweld) — to see; verbal noun, soft-mutated after dy 'your' (dy welet ti 'seeing you', literally 'your seeing') · also soft after o 'from, because of' (o welet gwr kymeint a gerynt 'from seeing a man so loved by them')
mynet: mynet (mynd) — to go; verbal noun (amser mynet y uwyta 'time to go to eat')
ulwydyn: blwydyn (blwyddyn) — year; noun f., soft-mutated after y/the feminine article (hyt ym penn y ulwydyn) · also adverbial, 'a year' in time phrases, soft-mutated without the article (ulwydyn y heno 'a year from tonight'; ual yd eistedyssant ulwydyn o'r nos honno 'as they sat a year from that night'), the soft mutation being that of an adverbial accusative of time
duc: dwyn (dwyn) — to bring, carry, take; 3 sg. preterite 'took' (Ruthyr a duc 'he made a rush', literally 'a rush he took'); no mutation shown after a (d for dd)
chedymdeithon: kedymdeith (cydymaith) — companions; noun pl., spirant-mutated after a (ac ymdidan a chedymdeithon 'and talk with companions')
beichogi: beichogi (beichiogi) — pregnancy, conception; noun m./verbal noun (y byd beichogi idi 'there will be pregnancy to her'); no mutation shown
idi: idi (iddi) — to her; 3 sg. f. conjugated form of y 'to' (menegi... a wnaeth idi)
guedy: guedy (gwedi) — after; preposition (A guedy y medwl hwnnw 'and after that thought')
treulaw: treulaw (treulio) — to spend, pass (time); verbal noun, base form
yr: yr — (1) the article 'the' before a vowel (yr erchwys); (2) 'for, for the sake of' preposition (yr Duw 'for God's sake', yr guaret gormes 'for removing the oppression') · (3) 'for all, however' before an equative-type noun and a clause (yr araued y kerdei y uarch 'for all the slowness with which his horse went'); (4) in yr meityn 'for a while (since)'; (5) the verbal particle y, yd, written yr before a vowel (yr ymordiwedei a hi 'that he would overtake her') · also (6) the perfective particle ry written yr, softening the verb (yr gyscwys 'has slept'); the article before an independent possessive (yr eidunt 'theirs'); 'for' with an abstract noun (yr bychanet 'for the smallness')
mab: mab (mab) — son, boy; noun m. (mab a anet idaw 'a son was born to him'); no mutation (subject, fronted)
anet: geni (geni) — to be born; impersonal preterite 'was born' (mab a anet idaw 'a son was born to him'); soft-mutated (g>∅) after the relative a
sef: sef (sef) — it is (this), that is; presentative particle introducing an explanation or answer
enw: enw (enw) — name; noun m. (y enw ef 'his name')
dodet: dodi (dodi) — to put; impersonal 'has been put', after the perfective particle ry (ry dodet ymman 'has been put here') · also impersonal preterite 'was put, was laid' after the relative a (Sef penyt a dodet erni 'this is the penance that was laid on her'; Sef enw a dodet arnaw 'the name that was given him') · also impersonal preterite after the particle y (wrth hynny y dodet ar y kymwt hwnnw 'for that reason it was put on that commote')
uab: mab (mab) — son; noun m., soft-mutated after a personal name in a patronymic (Guawl uab Clut 'Gwawl son of Clud') · also soft after predicative yn (yn uab y wr arall 'a son of another man'; yn uab y Pwyll 'a son of Pwyll')
rodi: rodi (rhoi) — to give, put; verbal noun, base form
uaeth: maeth (maeth) — fosterage, nurture; noun m. (ar uaeth 'in fosterage'); soft-mutated (m>u) after the preposition ar 'on'
wnaethpwyt: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; impersonal preterite 'was done', soft-mutated after a (a wnaethpwyt 'was done'), -pwyt as the impersonal ending
un: un (un) — one; numeral/adjective (un dyrnaut 'one blow') · also 'same' (yn un ansawd 'in the same appearance'; yr un ford 'the same way') and the pronoun 'one (of them)' (Un a gyuodes 'one rose')
lle: lle (lle) — place; noun m., base unmutated form
goreu: goreu (gorau) — best; superlative of da 'good' (Goreu yw gennyf 'it is best with me' = I prefer)
wyr: gwyr (gwŷr) — men; noun pl., soft-mutated after yn (yn wyr ymi 'as men to me') · also soft after o 'of' (o wyr 'of men') and in address (A wyr 'O men') · also soft after y 'to' (y wyr Dyuet 'to the men of Dyfed') and y 'his' (y wyr 'his men')
eil: eil (ail) — second; ordinal numeral (yr eil 'the second')
llyma: llyma (dyma) — behold, here is; presentative particle throwing a scene before the reader (llyma yr erchwys)
am: am — preposition 'about, around; concerning' (am y uynwgyl 'about his neck'; am dir a dayar 'about land') · also 'for, in return for' (am y gam 'for his wrong'; am pob un 'for each one')
gawssei: caffael (cael) — to get; 3 sg. pluperfect 'he had got' (y douot a gawssei 'the doubt he had got'), -ssei; soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
yg: yn (yn) — in; preposition, spelt yg before a g: the g is the written trace of the nasal mutation (yg gwyd = yng ngwyd 'in the presence of'; yg got = yng nghod 'in a bag', with c>ngh after yn 'in') · also before k-: yg kylch y ty 'around the house' (yng nghylch), the g being the trace of the nasal mutation (c>ngh)
r: 'r — the article yr contracted after a vowel, apostrophe half of a'r, y'r, o'r etc.: 'the'
idaw: idaw (iddo) — to him; 3 sg. m. conjugated form of y 'to'
ueirch: march (march) — horse; plural meirch; soft-mutated (m>u) after the possessive dy 'your' (dy ueirch 'your horses')
maeth: maeth (maeth) — fostering, nurture, fosterage; noun m., in mab maeth 'foster-son' (mab maeth ynni uyd 'he will be a foster-son to us'); no mutation
gwyr: gwr (gŵr) — men; noun pl. (kymryt gwrogaeth y gwyr 'taking the homage of the men')
gantaw: gan (gan) — 'with him'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. m., spelt gantaw (hyspys oed gantaw 'it was known to him'); no mutation
heb: heb — (1) 'said' (heb ef 'said he'), a defective verb used only for tagging speech; (2) 'without' + verbal noun (heb hanbwyllaw 'without troubling') · (3) 'past, beside' in heb law (heb law yr orssed 'past the mound'); see hebdaw
nachaf: nachaf (no modern form) — behold, lo; presentative particle that sets the scene before the eyes (nachaf un o'r llongeu 'behold one of the ships'); no mutation
dygyuor: dygyuor (dygyfor) — to muster, rally (a hunt); verbal noun (dechreu dygyuor yr hela 'beginning to muster the hunt') · also noun 'muster, gathering' (Dygyuor y wlat a doeth attunt 'the muster of the land came to them')
nat: na, nat (nad) — 'that … not'; negative conjunction of a subordinate clause, nat before a vowel (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there')
oed: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect 'was' (Pwyll... a oed yn arglwyd) · also oed 'appointed time, tryst', noun m., = oet (gwna oed a mi 'make an appointment with me')
ony: ony (oni) — unless, until; conjunction ('no, unless …'), causes spirant mutation of c, p, t (ony chyuyt 'unless there rise') · also with soft mutation of g (ony wybydaf i 'if I do not find out')
dial: dial (dial) — vengeance, revenge; noun m. (na dial uyth 'nor vengeance ever')
gyrru: gyrru (gyrru) — to drive; verbal noun (gyrru yr erchwys … e ymdeith 'driving the pack away')
ystauell: ystauell (ystafell) — room, chamber; noun f. (na guas ystauell 'no chamber-servant')
llys: llys (llys) — court; noun f., base form
pheri: peri (peri) — to cause, command; verbal noun, spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and' (a pheri dodi gostec 'and having a proclamation made')
gwedy: gwedy (gwedi) — after; preposition, the spelling beside guedy (A gwedy y bwyta kyntaf 'and after the first eating')
bei: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'were, would be' (bei ar y gam 'if it were at its step' = at a walk)
dyuot: dyuot (dyfod) — to come; verbal noun (a dyuot y Lynn Cuch 'and coming to Glyn Cuch')
tharaw: taraw (taro) — to strike; verbal noun (a tharaw y ureich 'and to strike off the arm'); spirant-mutated (t>th) after a 'and'
arnei: ar — conjugated preposition 'on her' (a charyat arnei 'and love on her') · also 'on it', of a feminine noun (a eistedo arnei 'who may sit on it', of the mound)
beunyd: beunyd (beunydd) — daily, every day; adverb (eisted gyr llaw hwnnw beunyd 'to sit beside it daily'); no mutation
gwnaethpwyt: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; impersonal preterite 'was done' (Ac yuelly y gwnaethpwyt 'and so it was done'), -pwyt; no mutation after the particle y
ie: ie — yes; particle of assent, taking up what was just said
arglwyd: arglwyd (arglwydd) — lord; noun m., term of address
wrth: wrth (wrth) — to, towards, according to; preposition, base form (dywedut... wrthaw) · also 'at' (wrth y danned 'at the teeth'; wrth yr ascwrn 'at the bone') and 'because of' (wrth hynny 'for that reason')
uatholwch: Proper name — Matholwch; soft-mutated (m>u) after the preposition y 'to' (rodi Branwen y Uatholwch), after at 'to' (at Uatholwch) and as subject after a verb (a diwedyssei Uatholwch)
llongeu: llong (llong) — ship; plural llongeu 'ships'; no mutation (after the article y 'the'; y llongeu hynn 'these ships')
ual: ual (fel) — as, like; conjunction/preposition (ual hynn 'like this') · also 'so that' (ual yd ymglywynt 'so that they could hear one another'; ual y bydynt gadarnach 'so that they would be stronger') and 'how' (sef ual yd eistedyssant 'that is how they sat')
el: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may go' (A phan el ef 'when he goes'; yny el ef dros y pen 'until he goes over the head')
neb: neb (neb) — anyone; pronoun, used with a positive sense in relative/superlative clauses (o'r a welsei neb 'that anyone had seen') · also 'anyone' under a negative = 'no one' (ny thykya y neb ymlit 'it avails no one to pursue') · also in y neb a 'the one who/to whom' (y neb a dylyer y kymryt y ganthaw 'the one from whom one ought to take it')
del: dyuot (dod) — to come; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may come' (a del yn waredauc 'whoever comes submissively')
wynt: wynt (hwynt) — they, them; 3 pl. pronoun (un lliw ac wynt 'the same colour as them') · also Wynt, Gwent, in the name Wynt Ys Coet 'Gwent Is Coed', a region of south-east Wales
at: at — preposition 'to, towards' (at y cwn 'to the dogs')
rac: rac (rhag) — before, lest, to prevent, for fear of; preposition (dyro ui idaw rac anglot yt 'give me to him to spare you dishonour')
gwybot: gwybot (gwybod) — to know; verbal noun (ef yn gwybot y uot yn uab 'he knowing that he was a son'); no mutation
hynn: hynn (hyn) — 'this'; demonstrative, substantive use in ual hynn 'like this, thus' · also adjective 'this' after its noun (seith cantref hynn 'these seven cantrefs')
nit: nyt (nid) — negative particle 'not, there is not', spelling before a vowel (Nit oes; Nit yttoydwn)
no: no (na) — than, comparative particle (no gyrru 'than driving'; no chyuedach)
buant: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. preterite 'they were' (Ny buant 'they were not')
meithryn: meithryn (meithrin) — to nurse, foster, rear; verbal noun, fronted before a wnaethpwyt (Meithryn y mab a wnaethpwyt 'the boy was reared'); no mutation
wnaeth: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 sg. preterite 'he did', soft-mutated after a; auxiliary in 'verbal noun + a wnaeth' (dechreu ymdidan a wnaeth)
hitheu: hitheu (hithau) — conjunctive form of hi 'she', 'she for her part'
dal: tal (tal) — payment, price; noun m.; soft-mutated (t>d) after the possessive y 'his' (y dal 'his payment')
menegi: menegi (mynegi) — to tell, relate; verbal noun (menegi y holl gyfranc a wnaeth idi)
ryw: ryw (rhyw) — some, some kind of; before its noun (ryw ystyr hut 'some meaning of magic')
brawt: brawt (brawd) — brother; noun m.; no mutation (subject after y may 'that it is'; y may brawt un uam a mi 'that it is a brother of one mother with me')
dwyn: dwyn (dwyn) — to carry, bring; verbal noun (dwyn y dwy dyrnas yn un 'bringing the two kingdoms into one')
anuon: anuon (anfon) — to send; verbal noun ('anuon o pop un y gilid' 'each one sending to the other')
doeth: dyuot (dod) — to come; 3 sg. preterite 'came' (a doeth 'and came')
ynys: ynys (ynys) — island; noun f. (yr ynys hon 'this island'); no mutation
honn: hon (hon) — 'this' (f.); variant spelling of hon (no'r ulwydyn honn 'than this year')
uendigeiduran: Proper name — Bendigeidfran; spelling with -d; soft-mutated (b>u) after the preposition wrth 'to' (wrth Uendigeiduran 'to Bendigeidfran')
yscwyd: ysgwydd (ysgwydd) — shoulder; noun f., in the epithet Unic Glew Yscwyd; no mutation (vowel-like, ys-)
yny: yny (hyd oni) — until; so that; conjunction, with a vivid present (yny hyllt, yny dyrr, yny uyd) or the subjunctive for a future goal (yny delych) · also in Ac ar yny llyma, a slip for ar hynny 'thereupon', kept as written (the Red Book has ar hynny) (Ac ar yny, llyma y teulu 'and thereupon, behold the warband')
kyuanned: kyuanned (cyfannedd) — dwelling, habitation; noun m./f. (y llys a'r kyuanned)
yna: yna (yna) — then; adverb (Yna y rodes Arawn y furuf)
kymryt: kymryt (cymryd) — to take, receive; verbal noun (iawn yw gymryt; kymryt gwrogaeth)
edrych: edrych (edrych) — to look; verbal noun (edrych ar y carw 'to look at the stag')
doluryaw: dolurio (dolurio) — to grieve, be pained; verbal noun, fronted before a wneuthum (a doluryaw a wneuthum 'and I grieved'); no mutation
poen: poen (poen) — pain, torment, punishment; noun f./m. (gadu poen kymmeint 'to allow so great a pain'; o'r poen 'from the pain'); no mutation
uranwen: Proper name — Branwen; soft-mutated (b>u) after the preposition gan 'with' (gan Uranwen 'with Branwen')
dechreu: dechreu (dechrau) — to begin; verbal noun (dechreu dygyuor 'beginning to muster') · also the noun 'beginning' (ar dechreu kyuedach 'at the start of the carousing')
peri: peri (peri) — to cause, make, have (something done); verbal noun, fronted before a wnaeth (Peri dwyn y gassec y mywn ty a wnaeth 'he had the mare brought into the house'); no mutation
kennadeu: kennat (cennad) — messenger; plural kennadeu 'messengers' (cenhadon); no mutation (subject, radical: Sef kennadeu a aeth 'the messengers who went')
attaw: at — conjugated preposition 'to him' (y marchawc a doeth attaw 'the horseman came to him')
hun: hun (hun) — self, own; also 'sleep' as a separate noun by context (e hunan/e hun 'himself'; kymryt hun 'to take sleep')
cwynaw: cwynaw (cwyno) — to lament, complain; verbal noun (mynychu cwynaw truanet damwein Riannon 'often lamenting the wretchedness of Rhiannon's mishap'); no mutation
bot: bot (bod) — to be; verbal noun (hyt na bo... uot 'so that there be...')
chwaer: chwaer (chwaer) — sister; noun f. (dy chwaer 'your sister'; yn chwaer y minheu 'a sister to me'); no mutation (chw- has no mutated form after dy or yn)
kynghor: kynghor (cyngor) — counsel, advice; noun m., base form (Kynghor yw hynny 'that is counsel'; gan gynghor 'by the counsel')
gahat: caffael (cael) — to get; impersonal preterite 'was got' (Sef a gahat yn y kynghor 'what was got in the counsel'), kahat; soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
kyrchu: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, head towards; verbal noun (Kyrchu y llys a oruc ynteu)
adaw: adaw (gadael) — to leave; verbal noun, a form without g- (A dyuot cof idaw adaw y drws yn agoret 'and he remembered leaving the door open'); no mutation
marchawc: marchawc (marchog) — horseman, rider; noun m., base form
achaws: achaws (achos) — cause, reason; noun m. ('Pa achaws' 'what reason, why')
oedynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. imperfect 'they were' (nit oedynt unllef)
hir: hir (hir) — long; adjective (yn hir 'for a long time')
unic: Proper name — Unig (Unic), in Unic Glew Yscwyd 'Unig Strong-Shoulder', one of Bendigeidfran's men; radical
glew: glew (glew) — bold, valiant, strong; adjective, in the epithet Unic Glew Yscwyd; no mutation
idic: Proper name — Iddig (Idic), son of Anarawg, one of the messengers; radical
anarawc: Proper name — Anarawg (Anarawc), father of Iddig; radical (after uab)
dyuet: Dyuet (Dyfed) — proper name, the region of south-west Wales
was: gwas (gwas) — lad, servant; noun m., soft-mutated in address (Ha was 'ho, lad'; Bid parawt … was 'be ready, lad') and after wrth (wrth was y uarch 'to his groom', literally 'the lad of his horse')
wy: wynt (hwynt) — they; 3 pl. pronoun, spelling variant (heb wy 'said they')
arnunt: ar — conjugated preposition 'on them' (Sef lliw oed arnunt 'this was the colour that was on them')
bendigeiduran: Proper name — Bendigeidfran (Bendigeid 'blessed' + bran 'raven, crow'), son of Llŷr, king of the Island of the Mighty; bran is soft-mutated (b>u, u = f) as the second element of the compound; the name itself is unmutated as subject (Bendigeiduran uab Llyr a oed urenhin)
yniuer: niuer (nifer) — company, host; noun m. with prosthetic y- (yr yniuer y buam doe 'the company that we were yesterday')
nyt: ny (nid) — negative particle 'not, it is not', spelling before a vowel or in emphasis (nyt teilygdawt)
uawr: mawr (mawr) — great, big; adjective (grauanc uawr 'a great claw'); soft-mutated (m>u) after a feminine noun
weilgi: gweilgi (gweilgi) — the open sea, the main (a poetic word); noun f.; soft-mutated (gw>w) after the feminine article y (uch penn y weilgi 'above the head of the sea')
aeth: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 sg. preterite 'went' (a'y vreic a aeth attaw 'and his wife went to him')
namyn: namyn (namyn) — except, but; conjunction (namyn ti 'but you')
dwy: dwy (dwy) — two (f.); numeral, causes soft mutation of a following feminine noun (y dwy dyrnas 'the two kingdoms')
gelwit: galw (galw) — to call; 3 sg. impersonal imperfect 'he was called' (y gelwit Pwyll Penn Annwuyn)
pan: pan (pan) — when; temporal conjunction with a past-time clause (pan doeth) · also interrogative 'from where, whence' (pan doy di? 'where do you come from?')
geuyn: keuyn (cefn) — back; noun m., soft-mutated after 'y (a'y geuyn attei 'and his back to her')
chyrchu: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, head towards; verbal noun, spirant-mutated after a (a chyrchu y bordeu 'and making for the tables')
tir: tir (tir) — land, territory; noun m. (dylyedauc tir a dayar 'a lord of land and earth')
dydgueith: dydgueith (no modern form) — one day, on a day; dyd 'day' + gweith 'time', adverbial (Ac ar hynny dydgueith 'and at that, one day'); no mutation
troi: troi (troi) — to turn; verbal noun (Troi yn y hol a oruc ef 'he turned after her') · also 'to wrap, wind about' (guedy troi llenn o bali yn y gylch 'having wrapped a cloth of brocade about him')
kylch: kylch (cylch) — circle, ring, surrounding; noun m. (yn eu kylch 'around them'; yg kylch y ty 'around the house'); no mutation
vy: uy (fy) — my; possessive pronoun, triggers nasal mutation, spelt with v (Vy ngwyrda kywir)
guell: guell (gwell) — better; comparative adjective, in kyuarch guell 'greet' (literally 'ask better')
rodo: rodi (rhoi) — to give; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may he give' (Duw a rodo da ywch 'may God give you good'); after the particle a soft mutation of rh is not distinguishable in the spelling (r for rh)
ywch: y (i) + chwi — 'to you'; conjugated preposition, 2 pl. (rodo da ywch 'may he give good to you'); no mutation
chwedleu: chwedl (chwedl) — tale, story, talk; noun f., plural chwedleu (y chwedleu ereill 'the other tales'); ch- does not mutate here
mae: bot (bod) — to be; irregular present 3 sg. 'is, there is' (y mae arnat o anryded) · also interrogative 'where is?' (Mae yr yniuer …? 'where is the company …?')
ryued: ryued (rhyfedd) — wonder, marvel; noun m., also the adjective 'strange' (ryued oed genhyf 'it was a wonder with me'); no mutation
coet: coet (coed) — wood, forest; noun m. (dan y coet 'under the wood')
welsam: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 1 pl. preterite 'we saw' (na welsam eiroet 'we have never seen'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after na 'that ... not'
eiryoet: eiryoet (erioed) — ever; variant spelling of eiroet (o'r a welsei eiryoet 'of all he had ever seen')
llyna: llyna (dyna) — there is, behold that; presentative particle, distal counterpart of llyma
beth: beth — what; interrogative pronoun (beth amgen 'what else?', beth a wnaf 'what shall I do?')
eres: eres (no modern form) — strange, wonderful; adjective, here predicative (eres genhyf 'strange with me', i.e. I find it strange); no mutation (vowel)
dim: dim — anything, nothing; indefinite pronoun (ny russya dim ragot 'nothing will obstruct before you')
gyr: ger (ger) — near, beside; preposition, spelt gyr (gyr y bron 'beside her breast'; gyr llaw hwnnw 'beside that'); no mutation
llaw: llaw (llaw) — hand; noun f., in the idiom uch llaw 'above, overlooking' (uch llaw y llys 'above the court') · also gyr llaw 'beside, next to' (eisted gyr llaw hwnnw 'to sit beside it')
gerdet: kerdet (cerdded) — going, pace; verbal noun/noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (y gerdet 'to go'), after vn 'same' (vn gerdet; why is not clear, kerdet being usually masculine), and in amgen urys gerdet 'other haste of pace' (cause unclear) · also soft-mutated after pa 'what' (pa gerdet yssyd arnawch chwi 'what journey is on you?') and after llyna (Llyna gerdet 'there is the journey')
aruchel: aruchel (aruchel) — very high, lofty; adjective, ar- + uchel 'high' (mawr aruchel 'big and very tall')
llynn: llynn (llyn) — drink; noun m. (bwyt a llynn 'food and drink')
pop: pob (pob) — each, every; adjective, spelling variant (o pop un y gilid)
phob: pob (pob) — every, each; adjective (a phob nos Calanmei 'and every May-eve'); spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and'
peth: peth (peth) — thing; noun m., used with bynnac 'whatever' (Peth bynnac o garueidrwyd)
oll: oll (oll) — all, wholly; adverb/adjective intensifying a preceding noun (yr arueu oll 'all the armour')
ynteu: ynteu (yntau) — 'he, for his part'; conjunctive pronoun marking a change of speaker or actor (heb ynteu)
oes: bot (bod) — to be; present 3 sg. existential 'there is' (Nit oes yndi nep)
arglwydes: arglwydes (arglwyddes) — lady; feminine of arglwyd, term of address
di: di — 'you' (sg.), echoing pronoun after a verb or possessive (y pryny di; dy gerennyd di); also the object 'you' (ni ladaf i di)
yw: bot (bod) — to be; present 3 sg. copula 'is', used in equative sentences (Sef yw hwnnw, Hafgan)
kyn: kyn (cyn) — before; with a verbal noun (kyn uy rodi 'before my being given') · also the equative particle 'as', softening the adjective (kyn debycket a'r mab 'as like as the boy')
bwyf: bot (bod) — to be; 1 sg. present subjunctive 'I may be' (kyt bwyf i yno 'though I be there')
mi: mi — 1 sg. independent/emphatic pronoun 'I' (mi a wnn 'I know')
wnn: gwybot (gwybod) — to know; 1 sg. present 'I know', soft-mutated after a/ny, g dropped (mi a wnn; ny wnn i)
drwod: drwod (drosodd) — across, over; adverb (y doeth ef drwod attat ti 'he came across to you'); no mutation
uym: uy (fy) — my; possessive pronoun, 1 sg., written uym with the nasal on it before p (uym penyt 'my penance'; uym pryder 'my care'); causes nasal mutation, here written only on the possessive, the noun left unchanged
m: 'm — infixed/proclitic pronoun, apostrophe half of a'm, y'm, o'm etc.: 'my' (possessive, triggers soft mutation) or 'me' (object) · with h- before a following vowel (o'm hanwod 'against my will'); as 'my' before a verbal noun it may stand for that noun's object (a'm rodi 'and my giving' = and giving me); as 'me' after a relative (a'm gwrthyt 'who rejects me')
mor: mor (mor) — so, how; adverbial intensifier, triggers soft mutation (mor lwydannus) · also môr 'sea' (hyt y mor 'as far as the sea'); noun m., no mutation
och: och (och) — alas; interjection of dismay (Och! heb y Riannon 'Alas, said Rhiannon')
gan: gan (gan) — with, by; preposition, softening the next word; possession is 'with' a person or thing (oed gan y march 'the horse had', literally 'was with the horse'); y gan 'from' (y gan y uarch 'from his horse'); base of gennyf, ganthaw, genthi etc. · also 'from', without y (ny chaffei namyn yr un atteb gan y gwraged 'she would get only the same answer from the women'; yny gigleu gan lawer 'until he heard from many')
ystlys: ystlys (ystlys) — side, edge; noun f. (ystlys y llannerch 'the edge of the clearing')
yndi: yn (yn) + hi — conjugated preposition 'in her/it', feminine (Nit oes yndi nep; y guassanaeth yndi)
deu: deu (dau) — two (m.); numeral, causes soft mutation of a following noun (y deu wrenhin 'the two kings')
lynn: Glynn (Glyn) — 'glen, valley'; the g of Glynn drops after y 'to' (y Lynn Cuch 'to Glyn Cuch')
holl: holl (holl) — all, whole; adjective, precedes its noun causing soft mutation (yr holl gyuoeth 'the whole realm')
ymlad: ymlad (ymladd) — to fight; verbal noun (yn herwyd ymlad a frouedigaeth y gorff)
gyflym: kyflym (cyflym) — swift; adjective, soft-mutated (k>g) after yn (yn gyflym caeu y got 'quickly shutting the bag')
chynghor: kynghor (cyngor) — counsel, advice; noun m.; spirant-mutated (k>ch) after a 'and' (a chynghor a gymerwn 'and counsel we will take', the object put first)
wyrda: gwyrda (gwyrda) — noblemen; noun pl., base form, gwyr 'men' + da 'good' (A wyrda, heb ef) · also soft after o 'of' (a chan hynn o wyrda 'and with these noblemen', literally 'of noblemen')
gynghor: kynghor (cyngor) — counsel, advice, will; noun m., soft-mutated after possessive y 'his' (wrth y gynghor ef 'by his counsel'; gan gynghor 'by the counsel of') · also soft as the object of a verb (mi a wnn gynghor da 'I know good counsel') · also soft after a preceding adjective (yn y kyuyng gynghor 'in the narrow counsel') and as object (ni a gymerwn gynghor 'we will take counsel')
gadu: gadu (gadael) — to leave; verbal noun, soft-mutated after eithyr (eithyr gadu 'except to leave')
rot: y rwng (rhwng) — between; y rot is the 2 sg. conjugated form 'between you', modern rhyngot (y rot a'th uarchogyon 'between you and your horsemen'), as y rof 'between me' in y rof i a Duw
thorri: torri (torri) — to cut, break, cut off; verbal noun (a thorri y guefleu 'and cutting the lips'); spirant-mutated (t>th) after a 'and'
yssyd: bot (bod) — to be; relative present 'is, who/that is' (sydd) (Gwr yssyd gyuerbyn; pa amgen uedwl yssyd yndaw)
eill: gallu (gallu) — to be able; 3 sg. present, irregular form 'may, can' (ef a eill uot 'it may be')
dy: dy — 'your' (sg.); possessive pronoun, causes soft mutation (dy gerennyd 'your friendship') · also written for the affixed pronoun di 'you' after the presentative wely (Ac wely dy yna dy uab 'and there, behold, is your son')
uo: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may be', soft-mutated after phan 'when' (phan uo ef ar perued 'when he is in the middle of') · also soft-mutated after the relative a (llathen aryant a uo kyuref 'a rod of silver that may be as thick')
penn: penn (pen) — head, end; noun m., base form (Penn Annwuyn 'Head of Annwfn')
bit: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperative 'let there be, let it be' (A bit corn canu da 'and let there be a good horn for blowing'; bit hynny yn arwyd 'let that be the signal'); modern bydded
uydaf: bot (bod) — to be; 1 sg. present/future 'I will be' (byddaf), soft-mutated after a (mi a uydaf hebryngyat arnat)
gyntaf: kyntaf (cyntaf) — first; superlative, soft-mutated after y (ar y gossot kyntaf 'at the first onset') · also adverbial 'fastest, soonest' (ual y gallei gyntaf 'as fast as he could')
geir: geir (gair) — word; noun m.; geir is the Middle Welsh spelling, no mutation after un with a masculine noun (un geir 'one word') · also 'near, by', a spelling of ger (ymauael a'r ebawl geir y uwng 'seizing the foal by its mane')
etwa: etwa (eto) — yet, still; adverb (nys mynnaf etwa 'I do not want him yet')
ohonaw: o + ef — conjugated preposition 'of/by him' (edrych ohonaw ef 'his looking')
arnaw: ar — conjugated preposition 'on him, on it' (llithiau dy erchwys dy hun arnaw 'feeding your own pack on it')
kyuarch: kyuarch (cyfarch) — to greet; verbal noun, literally 'ask better' (kyuarch guell 'greet')
uod: bod (bodd) — pleasure, will, liking; noun m., soft-mutated (b>u) after possessive y 'his' (wrth y uod 'according to his pleasure') · also soft-mutated after o 'of' (nyt o uod y neb a uedei y llys 'not by the will of anyone who held the court')
ditheu: ditheu (dithau) — conjunctive form of ti 'you' (sg.), 'you for your part'
th: 'th — infixed/proclitic pronoun, apostrophe half of a'th, i'th, dy'th etc.: 'your' (possessive) or 'you' (object)
wyd: gwyd (cf. gwedd) — manner, way; noun, soft-mutated after llyma (Llyma wyd y kyffy 'here is the way you will get it')
cam: cam (cam) — wrong, injustice; noun m. (cam a wnaeth 'he did wrong'); no mutation (fronted object)
mynnych: mynnu (mynnu) — to want, wish; 2 sg. present subjunctive 'you may wish' (y mynnych ti 'that you may wish')
ay: ay (ai) — is it?; interrogative particle (Ay uelly y mynny di 'is it so you wish?')
allaf: gallu (gallu) — to be able; 1 sg. present 'I can', with g lost by soft mutation after ny (Ny allaf ui … 'I cannot')
i: i — (1) emphatic independent pronoun 'I/me', echoing a verb or conjugated preposition (rof i, arnaf i); (2) spelling of y 'to' before a vowel or l/w (i waret); (3) spelling of y 'his' before some words (i wisc hela 'his hunting-dress') · (4) after ohonawch, probably the 2 pl. echoing pronoun chwi with its ch run into the ending (ohonawch i 'of you')
cael: caffael (cael) — to get, suffer, receive; verbal noun, cael beside caffael (ouyn cael kymriw 'fear of getting injury')
ys: ys (ys) — 'it is'; copula particle introducing a predicate, esp. in time expressions (ys blwydyn 'it is a year' = for a year) · also the infixed 3 sg. object 's 'it' after pei (pei ys guelwn 'if I saw it') · also 'below, under', is, in the name Wynt Ys Coet 'Gwent Is Coed'
ych: ych (eich) — your (pl.); possessive pronoun (kymerwch ych kyuarwyd)
chwi: chwi (chi) — 'you' (pl.); pronoun (y'ch kynnal chwi 'to maintain you')
hyn: hyn (hyn) — these; demonstrative pronoun (y un o hyn 'any one of these'); no mutation
ban: pan (pan) — when; conjunction, spelt ban here (ban uydynt, ban uei 'when they were, when it was'); the b is a spelling of the conjunction, followed by a soft-mutated verb
amgen: amgen — other, different; adjective/adverb ('beth amgen' 'what else?'; 'amgen noc' 'other than')
genhyf: gan (gan) — with, conjugated 1 sg. 'with me' (eres genhyf 'strange with me'; ryued oed genhyf 'it was a wonder with me'); the gan 'with' of opinion; no mutation
attep: attep (ateb) — answer, reply; noun m. (attep ny chauas ef 'he got no answer')
wynteu: wynt (hwynt) — they, for their part; conjunctive 3 pl. pronoun (Wynteu hagen ni wybuyssynt)
atteb: atteb (ateb) — answer, reply; noun m. (yr un atteb 'the same answer'); no mutation (vowel)
ninheu: ni (ni) — we, for our part; conjunctive 1 pl. pronoun (a gaussam ninheu)
attat: at (at) + ti — 'to you'; conjugated preposition, 2 sg. (y doeth ef drwod attat ti 'he came across to you'); no mutation
down: dyuot (dyfod) — to come; 1 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'I would come' (ny down yma 'I would not have come here', modern deuwn); no mutation shown after ny
arhoaf: arhos (aros) — to wait; 1 sg. present 'I (will) wait' (Arhoaf yn llawen 'I will wait gladly')
gyrchyssant: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for; 3 pl. preterite in -yssant 'they made for', soft-mutated after a (Yr orssed a gyrchyssant 'they made for the mound')
it: itt (iti) — to you; 2 sg. conjugated preposition, spelling variant with single t (achos it heuyt)
mywn: y mywn (i mewn) — in, inside; adverbial phrase (yn dyuot y mywn 'coming in')
ty: ty (tŷ) — house; noun m. (yn y ty yd oed cassec 'in the house was a mare'); no mutation
gwna: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 2 sg. imperative 'make!, do!' (gwna oed a mi 'make an appointment with me')
anryded: anryded (anrhydedd) — rank, standing; noun m./f. ('o anryded' 'of rank')
neill: neill (naill) — one (of two); (o'r neill parth 'on the one side')
thitheu: titheu (tithau) — you for your part; 2 sg. conjunctive pronoun, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A thitheu 'and you')
lu: llu (llu) — host, army; noun m.; soft-mutated (ll>l) after deu 'two' (y deu lu 'the two hosts')
arall: arall — other, another; adjective (yr erchwys arall 'the other pack') · also pronoun 'another (woman)' (heb arall 'said another')
enryded: anryded (anrhydedd) — honour, rank, dignity; noun f., spelt enryded (ual y bei y enryded 'according to his rank'); y 'his' gives no change before a vowel
gwneuthur: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; verbal noun/infinitive, also used as the periphrastic auxiliary 'do' (a wneuthum itt 'that I did to you')
chauas: caffael (cael) — to get; 3 sg. preterite, spirant-mutated after ny (ny chauas ef 'he did not get')
yndaw: yn (yn) + ef — conjugated preposition 'in him' (angheuawl dyrnawt yndaw ynteu; yssyd yndaw ef)
thi: ti (ti) — you; 2 sg. pronoun, spirant-mutated after a 'and, with' (gyt a thi 'together with you')
gymerth: kymryt (cymryd) — to take; 3 sg. preterite 'took', soft-mutated after a (Y march a gymerth 'he took the horse'; a gymerth rygyng 'took an amble')
gauas: caffael (cael) — to get, find, reach; 3 sg. preterite 'got', soft-mutated after a (a gauas 'got, reached')
llygru: llygru (llygru) — to spoil, corrupt, injure; verbal noun (eu llygru 'spoiling them'); no mutation
wlat: gwlat (gwlad) — land, country; noun f., soft-mutated after the feminine article or possessive (y wlat; i'th wlat)
genti: gan (gan) — 'with her'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. f., spelt genti (a chanawon genti 'and whelps with her'); no mutation
tangneued: tangneued (tangnefedd) — peace; noun f. (ef a barei tangneued 'he would make peace'); no mutation (object, radical)
gyweirwyt: kyweiraw (cyweirio) — to set in order, make ready; 3 sg. impersonal preterite 'there was a making-ready' (A'r neuad a gyweirwyt 'and the hall was made ready')
dodi: dodi (dodi) — to put; verbal noun (dodi y deudroet yn y got 'to put his two feet in the bag'; dodi llef ar y gorn 'to give a blast on the horn')
gwr: gwr (gŵr) — man; noun m. (y gwr a oed yn lle Arawn 'the man who was in Arawn's place')
aruawc: aruawc (arfog) — armed; adjective (llawn aruawc 'fully armed'); no mutation (vowel)
ym: yn (yn) — in; preposition, spelling variant before p/m/b (hyt ym Penn Llwyn Diarwya; ym perued) · also bot 1 pl. present 'we are' (yd ym y gyt 'we are together'; llibin yd ym pob blwydyn 'wretched that we are every year') · also 'my', a by-form of uy, in the oath ym kyffes y Duw 'by my confession to God' (the Red Book has ym kyffes i y Duw); the nasal mutation it brings is not written
pob: pob (pob) — each, every; adjective (pob un 'each one')
vn: un (un) — one; with the article 'the same'; written vn; softens a following feminine noun (yr vn march 'the same horse'; yr vn wisc 'the same garment'; vn gerdet 'the same pace')
ohonunt: o (o) + wynt — 'of them, from them'; conjugated preposition, 3 pl. (kyscu a wnaeth pawb ohonunt 'every one of them slept'); no mutation
eneit: eneit (enaid) — soul; used in address as an endearment 'dear one, my soul' (a dos y eisted, eneit 'and go to sit, friend')
benn: penn (pen) — head, top, end; noun m.; soft-mutated (p>b) after ar 'on' (ar benn gossed 'on top of a mound'; ar benn y pethewnos 'at the end of the fortnight')
guascu: gwasgu (gwasgu) — to press, tread down; verbal noun (a guascu a'y deudroet y bwyt 'and tread the food down with his two feet'); g not changed by a 'and'
ascwrn: ascwrn (asgwrn) — bone; noun m. (wrth yr ascwrn 'at the bone'); no mutation (vowel)
law: llaw (llaw) — hand; noun f., soft-mutated after heb in heb law 'past, beside' (heb law yr orssed 'past the mound') · also 'side' in ar neill law 'on one side' (ar neill law Pwyll 'on one side of Pwyll'), soft after neill; 'hand' after possessive 'th (y'th law 'in your hand')
gouyn: gouyn (gofyn) — to ask; 2 sg. imperative 'ask!' (Gouyn ueithon y Wawl weicheu 'ask Gwawl for sureties') · also verbal noun 'asking', g- lost by soft mutation after heb 'without' (heb ouyn 'without asking') and after y 'to' (y ouyn idaw 'to ask of him'); also in a gouyn a wnaeth 'asking he did'
wnai: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 sg. imperfect 'would do', soft-mutated after a (taraw a wnai pob un 'each would strike')
guare: gware (chwarae) — to play, play with; verbal noun, spelt guare (guare a'r got 'to play with the bag'; guare broch yg got 'the game of badger in the bag') · also noun 'game, sport, trick' (y tremic hwnnw a'r guare 'that insult and the sport')
edewis: adaw (gadael) — to leave, let go; 3 sg. preterite 'left', a>e by affection (Na gwr na gwreic o hynny nyt edewis Riannon 'not a man or woman of them did Rhiannon let go'); no mutation (vowel)
byw: byw — alive; adjective (ny byd byw ef 'he will not be alive')
eithyr: eithyr (eithr) — except; conjunction/preposition (eithyr gadu 'except to leave')
rei: rei (rhai) — some, some people; pronoun (rei o'r maes hwnn 'some of this field')
ereill: arall (arall) — other; plural ereill, the plural form of the adjective (y chwedleu ereill 'the other tales'); modern eraill
clywei: clywet (clywed) — to hear; 3 sg. imperfect 'heard, could hear' (a'e clywei wynteu 'heard them'); no mutation after the infixed 'e 'them'
arueu: arueu (arfau) — arms, armour; noun pl. (yny dyrr yr arueu oll 'so that all the armour breaks')
canu: canu (canu) — to sing, sound (a horn); verbal noun (canu y gorn 'sounding his horn')
barawt: parawt (parod) — ready; adjective, soft-mutated after predicative yn (yn barawt 'ready')
niueroed: niuer (nifer) — company, host, number; noun m., plural niueroed (y wled y'r teulu a'r niueroed 'the feast to the household and the hosts')
gyn: kyn (cyn) — as, equative particle before an adjective (kyn hygaret 'as lovable', spelt gyn after ny) · also soft-mutated in a run of epithets after the feminine noun morwyn (morwyn gystal, kyuurd, gyn anwylet 'a maiden so good, of equal rank, so dear')
eistedyssant: eisted (eistedd) — to sit; 3 pl. preterite in -yssant 'they sat', beside eistedyssont (ual yd eistedyssant 'as they sat')
bu: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. preterite 'was' (a uu 'was'; Llawen uu 'glad was')
